Quote.metaTitle: Instant towing and car transport quote
Quote.title: Get an instant price
Quote.intro: Enter where we pick up and deliver. You see an estimated price straight away.
Quote.noPrice: We need a moment to price this. Book anyway and the operator will confirm the price by phone, usually within 15 minutes.
Quote.noCoordinates: Pick the addresses from the suggestions so we can calculate the distance, or book and we'll call you with a price.
Quote.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
Quote.error: Something went wrong. Please try again or call us.
